invariants.rationale: The only way to return false is immediately if disabled is true.
All Java chars are non-negative, so character >= 0 always holds.
One of the early returns is if hasKeyboardFocus() returns false, so whenever the method returns true, it must have keyboard focus.

invariants.expression: result == false || (!disabled && (character >= 32 || character == BACKSPACE || character == TAB || character == NEWLINE || character == CARRIAGE_RETURN))
invariants.rationale: Result is only true if not disabled, and character is not a disallowed ASCII control character.
The event must be non-null for the function to process and return true; otherwise, a null event would yield an error earlier.
